title: Present Simple vs Present Continuous
summary: Choose Present Simple for routines and Present Continuous for actions happening now.

explanation.en: Present Simple is for repeated or usual actions. Present Continuous is for actions in progress now or temporary situations.
explanation.ru: Present Simple — для привычных и регулярных действий. Present Continuous — для действий сейчас и временных ситуаций.

examples.en: I walk to school every day.
examples.ru: Я каждый день хожу в школу пешком.

examples.en: I am walking to school now.
examples.ru: Я сейчас иду в школу пешком.

commonMistakes.note: Know is normally a state verb.
Use Present Continuous for an action happening now.
